W) Increasing the concentration of Cu 2+ ions near the anode
X) Increasing the concentration of Ag + ions near the cathode
Y) Increasing the area of the copper electrode
Z) Increasing the electrolyte pH
options: W) Increasing the concentration of Cu 2+ ions near the anode
X) Increasing the concentration of Ag + ions near the cathode
Y) Increasing the area of the copper electrode
